notes: U1 is clean: the SD of R2 across the LOO-CV folds is reported for both training (0.24) and validation (±0.51). The Bayesian optimisation with a GP is hyper-parameter tuning only, so not U2. Coded S1 = 1 (extrapolation) with med confidence; flag for adjudication.
